pathParams.name: sid
pathParams.description: HA resource ID. This consists of a resource type followed by a resource specific name, separated with colon (example: vm:100 / ct:100). For virtual machines and containers, you can simply use the VM or CT id as a shortcut (example: 100).

params.name: auto-rebalance
params.description: HA resource may be migrated during automatic rebalancing

params.name: delete
params.description: A list of settings you want to delete.

params.name: digest
params.description: Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.

params.name: failback
params.description: Automatically migrate HA resource to the node with the highest priority according to their node affinity  rules, if a node with a higher priority than the current node comes online.

params.name: max_relocate
params.description: Maximal number of resource relocate tries when a resource fails to start.

params.name: max_restart
params.description: Maximal number of tries to restart the resource on a node after its start failed. When reached, the HA manager will try to relocate the resource to an eligible node.
